review_scope.text_review: Exhaustive review of all 24 main steps and 10 remediation steps, including 69 top-level blocks, nested visual text, media summaries and bridges, step titles, recap previews, and referenced dataset text.
review_scope.interaction_review: One check per tile: all sampled prompts, options, feedback and hints reviewed for needs-to-understand dependencies. Sampling was expanded to half of interactions to cover every tile.

tile_findings.finding: Assignment, sign-in, access-test evidence and named SSO configuration/login remain within the current glossary scope. Object-read success is supplied evidence, not a requirement to understand later resource-policy evaluation. No STS-session mechanics or credential-expiry knowledge is required.

Allow rules, tracked responses, source-group references and DNS/metadata filtering exceptions are taught in this concept's glossary. Learners need not understand later connectivity diagnosis or EC2 provisioning to follow the supplied connection cases.

Provider pinning, bounded instance settings, init/plan/approved apply and resulting-setting verification are explicitly taught by the current glossary. The basic command sequence does not require the later reviewed-plan execution concept's additional knowledge. No modules, backend, state, drift, replacement or teardown concepts are needed.

Policy-field matching, bucket/object scope, contributed allows, explicit denies and the qualified general cross-account rule are current teaching. Supplied permission evidence does not require advanced grant exceptions, assumed-role setup, or later denied-request diagnosis.

Approved inputs, enrollment, organizational-unit placement and comparison of supplied checkpoint results are current teaching. Abstract checkpoint A/B evidence requires neither understanding nor designing a later security baseline. The Python automation preview is only a passing mention.

summary: No needs-to-understand dependency on a blocked future concept was found. Up-next references are previews rather than prerequisite knowledge. No leakage-related advisories were identified. Deterministic gates were not rerun, and generator reasoning or prior evaluator claims were not consulted.
